items.title: Lawrence Douglas Harris Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: Henry taught me a lot about leading bands and managing bands and booking

ctx.x: Well you mentioned a great man, the Lazy Daddy, any particular thing you would like to know about him?
Well just tell me a little bit how you played and you mentioned that, what did you say that his real name was? Henry Fillmore.
Well did he do anything else besides play piano? That's about all I ever know. Well we wouldn't want to mention his sideline.

items.title: Lawrence Douglas Harris Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Well you mentioned a great man, the Lazy Daddy... INTERVIEWEE: Well just tell me a little bit how you played and you mentioned that, what did you say that his real name was? Henry Fillmore.

ctx.x: But I mean playing it, that was a kick. That was a thousand dollars right back. Sure. Guys would ask me, how does it feel to walk up and drop a liquor in a jukebox and hear yourself play? I said oh man, there's nothing to it but hell I was thrilling inside you know. It was thrilling inside.
Well you mentioned a great man, the Lazy Daddy, any particular thing you would like to know about him?
Well just tell me a little bit how you played and you mentioned that, what did you say that his real name was? Henry Fillmore.
